state_code: # - Alaska Mathematics Standards, adopted June 2012 (current; no newer K-5 math set adopted as of 2026-10):
# - Official Excel and Word editions linked from https://education.alaska.gov/standards/mathematics :
#   https://education.alaska.gov/akstandards/math/adopted_math_edited7.25.22.docx (formatting edit, same standards as the 2012 PDF)
# - No official Alaska-to-CCSS crosswalk found on the DEED site. Mapping is by reading each Alaska standard against CCSS text.
# - Grade.Domain.Number with a trailing period in the documents (e.g. "1.MD.6."), written here without it. No cluster letters.
# - Domains follow CCSS but Alaska adds 1.CC (counting in grade 1), and numbers within a domain often differ from CCSS
#   (e.g. AK 3.MD.4 = CCSS 3.MD.B.3, AK 3.MD.9 = 3.MD.C.7, AK 4.MD.7 = 4.MD.C.5, AK 5.MD.3 = 5.MD.B.2). Do not match by number.
# - Lettered sub-parts (a, b, c...) are not separately coded in the Excel export; all are folded into their standard here.
# - "(L)" after a standard means it is locally assessed (3.MD.3, 3.MD.6, 4.OA.6, 4.MD.4, 4.MD.6, 5.MD.2, 5.MD.4).
# CCSS K-5 STANDARDS NOT COVERED: none (every CCSS K-5 standard maps to at least one AK row).
# - New: patterns in K, 1 and 2 (K.OA.6, 1.OA.9, 2.OA.5); days of the week (K.MD.4); ordinal numbers (1.CC.2); estimate then count (1.CC.6);
#   calendar and dates (1.MD.4); choosing measurement units incl. temperature (3.MD.3); data classification with min/max, range/mode,
#   mean/median (3.MD.6, 4.MD.6, 5.MD.4); elapsed time across U.S. (incl. Alaska) and world time zones (4.MD.4, 5.MD.2).
# - Moved earlier: time to the hour and naming coins in K (K.MD.5, K.MD.6); skip counting by 2s and 5s, money symbols, coin values in grade 1.
# - Extras in matched rows: make-5 in K.OA.4; counting backward in 1.CC.3; identity property in 1.OA.3; estimate first in 2.OA.1;
#   "create" word problems in 3.OA.8 and 3.MD.2; algebraic description of patterns in 4.OA.5; temperature and named units in 5.MD.1.
# - Narrowed: 5.OA.1 mentions parentheses only (CCSS adds brackets and braces); K.MD.3 drops sorting categories by count.
# - 1.CC.1 (skip count by 2s and 5s) marked moved to 2.NBT.A.2; counting by 2s itself is not a CCSS standard (2.OA.C.3 uses it for even numbers).
# - 1.CC.3, 1.CC.4, 1.CC.5 mapped as edited to grade 1 NBT standards; they are counting/comparing skills without the place-value framing.
# - 4.OA.6 (extend patterns, locally assessed) mapped to 4.OA.C.5 as edited; 2.OA.5 (number patterns with a rule) marked new though it
# - 5.MD.4 (mean, median) and 4.MD.6 (range, mode) are CCSS grade 6 statistics (6.SP); marked new since only K-5 CCSS codes are allowed.
# - K.MD.6 / 1.MD.5 / 1.MD.6 marked moved to 2.MD.C.8 (the only CCSS K-5 money standard); could be read as new.
# - 2.MD.9 broadens CCSS 2.MD.D.9 (length data on a line plot) to any data in tables, graphs or line plots: edited.
# - kind is judged on content: same = CCSS content with only rewording or small example changes.
